data: Phase 4: VIX term-structure slope, ln(VIX3M / VIX)
Same rows for every model: 2010-07-07 to 2026-11-09 (4,112 forecasts). VIX3M only starts 2006-07, so this is shorter than the main 8-model run. Lower QLIKE is better.
Diebold-Mariano test on QLIKE (negative = A better)

Tested and rejected (no gain in the 2016+ holdout): overnight gap, daily VIX change, down-day flag, SKEW, VVIX, day of week, options-expiry flag, fitting directly on QLIKE. VIX9D slope: small gain on a shorter sample (2015+), not added.
Last refreshed 2026-11-11. Source: outputs/slope_results.csv, outputs/slope_dm_tests.csv (python -m src.run_phase4).
